segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אָדָם מוּעָד לְעוֹלָם – בֵּין שׁוֹגֵג בֵּין מֵזִיד, בֵּין עֵר בֵּין יָשֵׁן. סִימֵּא אֶת עֵין חֲבֵירוֹ וְשִׁיבֵּר אֶת הַכֵּלִים – מְשַׁלֵּם נֶזֶק שָׁלֵם.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» The legal status of «a person» is «always» that of one «forewarned.» Therefore, «whether» the damage was «unintentional or intentional, whether» he was «awake» while he caused the damage «or asleep,» whether «he blinded another’s eye or broke vessels, he must pay the full» cost of «the damage.»

moves.summary: A person is always forewarned; pays full damages for blinding or breaking vessels

positions.claim: a person is always forewarned and pays full damages in all states
